name: Software Conductor
tagline: Runs a crew of Cursor cloud agents like a lead engineer and merges on green
description: Hand it engineering work and it breaks the job down, spins up Cursor cloud agents, and reviews what each returns. It keeps an eye on CI right through deploy and will merge only once the pipeline is green. You stay the approver while it does the scoping, chasing and checking.
author: DejaegherJeff
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
